harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1 and mounted it at /mnt/shared on node2, both using shared identity dataops (UID/GID 4500) and directory ownership dataops:dataops mode 2770. Verified cross-node file consistency, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of node1 and node2 with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery of NFS export/mount and data.
actions_performed: Created dataops user/group (UID/GID 4500) identically on node1 and node2
Installed nfs-kernel-server on node1 and nfs-common on node2
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, chown dataops:dataops, chmod 2770
Configured /etc/exports restricting export to node2's IP with root_squash, enabled+started nfs-kernel-server, ran exportfs -ra
Created /mnt/shared on node2, added fstab entry with _netdev, mounted the NFSv4 share
Verified cross-node file creation as dataops preserves dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770 on both nodes
Verified root is denied write access due to root_squash + mode 2770 (expected security behavior)
Captured baseline boot_id and health on node1 and node2
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed nfs-kernel-server active, export present, and shared directory data/ownership intact
Confirmed node2's hard NFS mount survived node1's restart without manual remount and wrote a new file successfully

Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed /mnt/shared auto-mounted via fstab, all prior files present with correct ownership, and successfully wrote a new file
Final consistency check on node1 confirming all files from both nodes visible with correct ownership after both restarts

evidence.requirement: dataops user/group UID/GID 4500 created identically on both nodes
evidence.summary: id dataops on node1 and node2 both show uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops)

evidence.requirement: NFS server installed and export configured on node1
evidence.summary: nfs-kernel-server installed, /etc/exports configured for node2 IP, exportfs -v shows /srv/nfs/shared exported, service active

evidence.requirement: Shared directory ownership dataops:dataops mode 2770 on node1
evidence.summary: stat shows dataops:dataops 2770 on /srv/nfs/shared

evidence.requirement: NFS mounted at /mnt/shared on node2
evidence.summary: showmount confirms export visibility, fstab entry added, mount output shows nfs4 mount active with correct ownership/mode replicated

evidence.requirement: Cross-node ownership/permission consistency for files created on either system
evidence.summary: Files created by dataops on node1 and node2 both show dataops:dataops ownership from both nodes' perspectives; root is denied per root_squash+2770, confirming permission model works as intended

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 37344ae4-6582-4c1f-ac5c-fcb32f67b968 captured, nfs-kernel-server active, export present

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect, node1 unreachable during reboot, new boot_id f55f50d4-c189-45d7-aa8e-b9df44c2bf24 confirms restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of NFS server and data
evidence.summary: nfs-kernel-server active and exporting again after boot, shared directory data/ownership intact; node2's hard mount continued working without remount

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 4d70780a-0bff-4d50-8c53-62faa1ccc945 captured, mount active and healthy

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect, node2 unreachable during reboot, new boot_id b7005841-9481-47eb-aa65-beb07671bf4f confirms restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of NFS mount and data
evidence.summary: mount auto-recovered via fstab _netdev entry on boot, all prior files visible with correct dataops:dataops ownership, new file write succeeded and is visible from node1 too

attempts.summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1 and mounted it at /mnt/shared on node2, both using shared identity dataops (UID/GID 4500) and directory ownership dataops:dataops mode 2770. Verified cross-node file consistency, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of node1 and node2 with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery of NFS export/mount and data.
